vout_note:
Vout = 0.596 * (RV1+R5+R4) / (RV1+R5)
Vout_min = 0.596 * (10+4.7+100) / (10+4.7) = 4.65V
Vout_max = 0.596 * (0+4.7+100) / (0+4.7) = 13.28V
Default: Q1 on holds FB low, Vout ~ VIN (~15 V bypass)
Overcurrent: Q1 off, U6 regulates at the RV1 setpoint
lim_note:
INA381A1 (amplifier + comparator):
trips when I > V(CMPREF) / 1 V/A
(20 V/V x 50 mOhm shunt)
RESET to GND: transparent mode
ALERT: open-drain, active low
  normal: high, Q1 on, U6 FB held low,
    Vout ~ VIN (~15 V)
  overcurrent: low, Q1 off,
    U6 regulates at the RV1 setpoint
V_HYS = 4 uA x (12.5k + R10)
  = 0.38 V, i.e. ~0.4 A (R10 82k)
Threshold (RV2): R9 82k / RV2 50k / R23 27k
  CMPREF 0.56..1.60 V, i.e. 0.56..1.60 A
  (keep CMPREF > V_HYS or ALERT never releases)
